original_record.question:
We consider the perimeter and the area of the region corresponding to the grey squares. How many more squares can we colour grey for the grey area to increase without increasing its perimeter?

answer_verification.method: 9 gray cells have perimeter20. Fill their5x5 bounding square: area25 and perimeter20, adds16. No shape of perimeter20 can exceed area25 (bounding width+height<=10, area<=width*height<=25).
